Package com.irurueta.units

Class ForceConverter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.units.ForceConverter
public final class ForceConverter extends Object
Does force conversions to different units. To prevent loss of accuracy, conversion should only be done as a final step before displaying force measurements.
